name: contrast-pair-field
title: Contrast pair field
description: Choose a text colour and a background and see the contrast ratio with AA and AAA verdicts in words, before the pair ships.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { foreground, background } and, going out, the ratio too: onValueChange gets { foreground, background, ratio } with the ratio from 1 to 21. Colours are #rrggbb (#rgb is read as well). Two colour pickers, Text and Background, share the swatches you give (swatches); a Swap button trades the two colours and says so. Where the field is narrower than 17.5rem the two pickers stack, Text above Background, and the Swap button turns to point up and down. Below them a sample is set in the pair, a large line (24px) and a normal one (16px), both of which you can change with sample. The ratio is written large in tabular figures (4.8:1) to two decimals, as the browsers' tools write it, but never rounded up to a number it does not reach: 4.499 is 4.49, not 4.5. Four checks are answered in words, each with an icon and a word and never by colour alone: Normal text AA (4.5:1) and AAA (7:1), Large text AA (3:1) and AAA (4.5:1). The verdicts are told to a screen reader once the colours stop changing. name adds hidden inputs <name>-foreground and <name>-background, and label names the group for a screen reader. normalizeHex, relativeLuminance, contrastRatio, formatRatio and contrastVerdicts are plain functions in contrast-pair-field/contrast, for a build step or a server.
